title: GTA6 Early Work and Scrapped Liberty City DLC Revealed in Massive 200GB GTA 5 Leak
description: A massive 200GB leak of GTA 5 source code reveals Rockstar Games once planned a massive Liberty City DLC and includes very early GTA 6 files.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Massive 200GB Leak Surfaces

According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Eurogamer, Rockstar Games has been impacted by a substantial data leak. The leaked data, reportedly sizing up to nearly 200GB of GTA 5 source code, sheds light on previously unknown development pathways within the studio.

The leak has quickly captured the attention of the gaming community, sparking discussions regarding decisions made by Rockstar Games during the years following the massive success of their flagship title.

## Scrapped Liberty City DLC Plans

Among the findings within the leaked source code are indications that Rockstar Games had initially started planning a massive Liberty City DLC for GTA 5. Liberty City, the iconic setting of GTA 4, was seemingly slated to make a return under the technical framework of the fifth installment.

However, the files suggest that these ambitious plans were ultimately scrapped by the developer. Industry observers and analysts note that this shift in focus was likely driven by the unprecedented, long-term success and ongoing development needs of GTA Online, as well as the studio's resource allocation toward Red Dead Redemption 2.

## Very Early GTA 6 Files Included

In addition to the canceled expansion content, the nearly 200GB leak reportedly contains very early files related to GTA 6. Given the massive development cycles typical of modern AAA blockbusters, the presence of early experimental data and foundational code is consistent with a studio transitioning between major projects.

It is important to emphasize that these files represent extremely early work stages and may bear little resemblance to the actual current state or features of GTA 6. Rockstar Games has not issued an official statement regarding the leak.

## Editor's Take

This 200GB leak offers a rare, unfiltered look into the behind-the-scenes decision-making at Rockstar Games. While it is unfortunate that the Liberty City DLC never materialized for fans to enjoy, the inclusion of early GTA 6 files highlights the long and intricate process of building a new open-world masterpiece. Players should view these unconfirmed, early development remnants with perspective as we await official news from the studio.
